ownership.scheduler: Owns the durable plan, time window, target owner/operation, exact allowed actions, signed dispatch fact, and delivery retry.
ownership.runtime_application: Owns only the source-neutral NotificationTargetRuntime port and target dispatch. It imports neither Scheduler nor Notification owner SDKs or implementations.
ownership.runtime_composition: Is the single Scheduler-to-Notification mapping boundary. It re-resolves current Identity, validates the narrow reminder contract, and calls public Notification SDK contracts.
ownership.notification: Owns notification event types, immutable inbox snapshots, preferences, channel plans, delivery reservations, retry state, and deduplication.
ownership.integration_connector: Integration owns external connection and provider invocation records; a project Connector executes the concrete channel request through the public Connector SDK.
ownership.storage: Runtime does not read or write Notification or Integration private tables and does not claim a cross-database atomic transaction.

reminder_contract.identity_source: current Identity SDK result at execution time

delivery_semantics.external_channels: opt in through the product Notification rule and a declared Integration connection
delivery_semantics.runtime_publication_status: accepted means Integration accepted the handoff
delivery_semantics.integration_invocation_status: succeeded records the concrete Connector result
delivery_semantics.callback_replay: the same signed callback returns replay=true and creates no second inbox item or provider call
